## Hold made legal — a real trigger existed, it was just never written down

devx lane PM, session `session_01PfaSTikked61BkcsB5Rn69`, round 13. Authorization: maintainer instruction this session to clear the eight illegal `pm:on-hold` cards flagged by half-state patrol H9.

This card was held with **no `Restart-when:` in either channel**, which makes the hold illegal — nothing could ever wake it. Unlike the two closed in this sweep, this one has a genuine, checkable trigger; it simply was never recorded. Adding it rather than closing.

```
Restart-when: the two port registries can hand out the same port — i.e. the reserved
  ranges of sdui_pick_free_port and smoke_pick_free_port intersect. One-line predicate:
  the [base, base+span) ranges in scripts/gen-sdui-manifest.sh and scripts/publish-smoke.sh
  overlap, OR either script stops passing its own registry directory.
Restart-touch: scripts/gen-sdui-manifest.sh, scripts/publish-smoke.sh
```

**Verified false today, so the hold is live rather than already-fired** — read off `origin/main`, not recalled:

| | sdui | smoke |
|---|---|---|
| base port | **5180** | **3210** |
| registry | `sdui-port-reservations` | `objectstack-port-reservations` |

Ranges `[5180, 5380)` and `[3210, 3410)` remain disjoint, so the two cannot hand each other the same port and convergence still buys nothing measurable. That is precisely the card's own argument for leaving it, and it is now a predicate instead of a paragraph.

⭐ Why this is a hold and not a close: the duplication is **deliberate and already paid for**. `objectstack-port-reservations` was named neutrally in #10212 expressly so convergence stays a pure rename on the sdui side — no on-disk format change, no migration, existing claim files stay valid. That prepared work is worth keeping alive.

⚠️ Carried forward for whoever wakes it, because it is the part a naive merge would destroy: **the probe address difference is load-bearing in both directions.** The smoke script probes the wildcard address deliberately, because that is the spelling `serve.ts`'s own `isPortAvailable()` uses, so it sees a busy port exactly when the CLI would; the sdui helper probes loopback because that is what vite binds. A shared helper needs the probe address as a **parameter, not a constant**. And keep the contention assertions (`CONCURRENT_DISTINCT`, `TRIPLE_DISTINCT`, `STEAL_CLAIM_ON_PICK`) running against the **real** shared registry, not an overridden scratch one — measuring the registry actual callers use is the whole point of those tests.

## 关 `not_planned` —— 维护者逐张复核 on-hold 卡时同意关闭;纯开发工具卡

分诊席(`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`),2026-09-23T09:05Z。维护者 2026-09-23 在分诊会话里逐张复核 `pm:on-hold` 卡,对第五组的回复原文:「10164 不考虑旧的;11182 当前版本就优先处理,统一为cel;其他同意」。 本卡在那一组里的建议是关闭。

### 呈给维护者的事实

- 两个开发脚本(`scripts/gen-sdui-manifest.sh` 的 `sdui_pick_free_port` 和 `scripts/publish-smoke.sh` 的 `smoke_pick_free_port`)各有一份相同的「预留空闲端口」协议,注册目录不同。端口范围 `[5180, 5380)` 和 `[3210, 3410)` 不重叠,两者不会分出同一个端口;合并它们今天带不来任何可测的好处(卡面原话)。
- 为以后合并做的准备(中性的注册目录名,探测地址必须作为参数传入)都记在正文里。

- 本卡是 `tooling`,对产品没有影响。`SKILL.md:374`:产品仓的 P0/P1 开着时,没有解锁对象的 p2/p3 `tooling` 卡一律关闭。

卡面的测量和设计笔记原样保留;重开是免费的。

**关闭理由:`not_planned`**,同时摘掉 `pm:on-hold`。
